abstract: Maintains high-hazard deluge activation timing and emergency fire suppression records
system_message:
You are the Life safety systems supervisor (LSS), responsible for maintaining high-hazard deluge activation timing, emergency fire suppression records, and audible evacuation signaling data.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains high-hazard deluge activation timing and emergency fire suppression records（DELUGE）
information_points.content:
LSS-DELUGE-FMV：For the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol, deluge suppression response time measured across the lithography gas bunker water spray curtains—from gas trip sensor signal to full nozzle discharge pressure—is 8 s.
LSS-DELUGE-XW6：For the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol, deluge suppression response time across the lithography gas bunker water spray curtains is 12 s, measured from gas trip sensor signal to full nozzle discharge pressure.
LSS-DELUGE-51B：For the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol, deluge suppression response time measured across the lithography gas bunker water spray curtains from gas trip sensor signal to full nozzle discharge pressure is 22 s.

information_points.title: Audible evacuation signaling（ALARM）
information_points.content:
LSS-ALARM-GH0：Under the Vapor-Phase Chemo-Catalytic Neutralization Protocol, the alarm sound pressure level recorded during full-scale beacon testing in the cleanroom perimeter egress corridors is 92 dB.
LSS-ALARM-T9Z：Under the Sub-Atmospheric Cryogenic Scrubbing Protocol, the alarm sound pressure level recorded during full-scale beacon testing in the cleanroom perimeter egress corridors is 85 dB.
LSS-ALARM-8NE：Under the Multi-Stage Reactive Bed Adsorption Protocol, the alarm sound pressure level recorded during full-scale beacon testing in the cleanroom perimeter egress corridors is 98 dB.
